target: Deterministic live-truth census for the whole Dopemux developer system: repo/runtime/config/services/state/open-PR/freshness facts only; no architecture adjudication
invariants: Current runtime/source/config/tests and live Git/GitHub state outrank uploaded snapshots, historical handoffs, plans, and architecture prose
Use OBSERVED, INFERRED, PROPOSED, CLAIMED, CONFLICTING, UNKNOWN, and NOT_RUN; every UNKNOWN names missing evidence

Preserve system boundaries: Dopemux coordinates; DCP controls policy/context; Dopetask executes only separately authorized work; Task Orchestrator owns workflow legality; canonical systems retain domain authority
No merge, mark-ready, activation, credential/permission change, production mutation, destructive action, history rewrite, or automatic execution authority is granted
No secrets, tokens, cookies, private keys, raw credentials, or sensitive provider payloads may enter research/proof artifacts
Ordinary main movement triggers affected-fact reharvest rather than blanket restart; exact SHA equality is required only where subject provenance requires it
R0 is deterministic fact acquisition: zero semantic model calls by default
Runtime/service probes must be read-only and local; provider/API spend calls are forbidden
R0 does not decide target architecture or component disposition

pr.title: docs(wsac): freeze live whole-system census
pr.body: Whole-system architecture convergence evidence. No merge, activation, production, credential, or runtime mutation authority.

steps.task: Reharvest live repository, branch, schema, governance, active runtime-entrypoint, and open-PR state from current main.
validation: Exact current main SHA/tree and working-base relationship are OBSERVED
Current AGENTS, governance rules, TP schema, runtime authority manifest, MCP catalog, model-routing policy, and relevant truth/system references are resolved from current main
Open PRs touching MCP, DCP, UAG/routing, context/memory, workflow, governance/audit, agents, or multi-project surfaces are inventoried with exact heads and changed paths
Uploaded July source bundle is labeled stale/orientation-only wherever its recorded blobs differ from current main

steps.task: Build deterministic service/runtime/config/state-store/entrypoint/path census without architecture judgment.
validation: Every listed service/system has source path, runtime entrypoint/status evidence class, persistence/state scope, transport if applicable, and authority owner if OBSERVED
Duplicate/ambiguous runtime entrypoints are preserved as CONFLICTING or UNKNOWN
No implementation intent is inferred from docs, package presence, names, or historical plans

steps.task: Build current open-work overlap and source-freshness map for downstream recon lanes.
validation: Each R1 lane receives watched path families and relevant open PRs
Moved heads are recorded without converting them into readiness claims
Source freshness disposition states exactly which uploaded/project-source files may be used only for orientation

steps.task: Freeze R0 census artifacts and run deterministic validation.
validation: Markdown and JSON agree on current base identity and counts
No runtime, GitHub, service, or canonical-state mutation occurs
